scope: Follow-up of shared ordinary inference, sessions/requests, typed error identity and complete-state transfer boundaries. Read-only source review of the named revision; no build, model run, GPU operation or download.
method: Read the design/progress completion claims and trace the named shared primitives into Qwen request/state adapters. Re-read focused consumer checks as source only. SHA256 below covers exact git-show blob bytes at the reviewed revision, not a later dirty working tree or a compiled image.

findings.subject: Request identity, cancellation, output credit and actual retirement
findings.result: No new confirmed defect in the inspected transitions. Active-span mutation is deferred; output drainage is separate from native retirement; late observation recovery does not by itself replay an old turn.

findings.subject: Complete-state parking and restoration boundary
findings.result: No new confirmed missing connection. The model adapter exports its complete state before eviction and clears the host image only after successful restoration; native copy acceptance, visibility and retirement remain with StateTransfer.

findings.subject: Typed error propagation
findings.result: check/take preserve the original Status through EvaluationFailure. RequestExecutionFailure only attributes qualified participants; unknown/native failures remain batch-wide. This is not a claim that every engine exception has been unified.

findings.subject: Escaped snapshot/model address reuse
findings.result: No confirmed ABA defect. A canonical State retains ColdResources, and math_identity names its retained family inventory. A replacement Model cannot reuse that mathematical address while the old snapshot keeps the inventory alive; create_session checks both model and math identities.

limits: No new confirmed defect in this finite scope is not proof of complete functionality or complete architecture migration.
GLM consumes shared Window/Progress/directory components; a second complete engine model has not validated all RequestLoop orchestration reuse.
This review does not prove unrun native-failure paths, model EOS/cold-tuple-refusal coverage, MTP device successor acceptance subsets, all backends or mixed-mode performance.
No speculative abstraction extraction or mechanical relocation was proposed solely because the Qwen implementation is large.
Concurrent/later performance or test changes are outside this immutable reviewed source identity.
